problem_context.problem_statement: Keep the existing exact prefix-node-suffix strong contract as strong_spec and add three common named specifications directly derived from it: remove_member_spec, remove_front_spec, and remove_tail_spec. The member specification removes only the first occurrence via a custom Coq function xizi_sll_remove_first. The C implementation and ABI must remain unchanged, and all generated derivation witnesses must be proved.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For the real netdev_unregister call, remove_member_spec is the default client view: membership is known, return value is ignored, and ownership of the detached node_next field is required for later overwrite. Front and tail specifications are convenience specializations.
problem_context.input_output_contract: strong_spec preserves the current exact result, remaining list app(l1,l2), and detached node old successor. remove_member_spec requires In(node,l) and ensures head(remove_first node l) * xizi_sll_node(node). remove_front_spec requires head(node::suffix) and ensures head(suffix) * xizi_sll_node(node). remove_tail_spec requires head(prefix++[node]) and ensures head(prefix) * xizi_sll_node(node). Simplified specs intentionally omit return equality and the old node_next value.
spec_hint: Define xizi_sll_remove_first in the case_lib with Z.eq_dec and return the tail immediately on the first match; do not use Coq.Lists.List.remove because it removes all equal occurrences. Add named forward declarations using remove_member_spec <= strong_spec, remove_front_spec <= strong_spec, and remove_tail_spec <= strong_spec, then verify the implementation under strong_spec.
preferred_hidden_properties: Membership yields a first-hit decomposition l = prefix ++ node :: suffix with node absent from prefix, so xizi_sll_remove_first node l = prefix ++ suffix.
The exact detached node_next points-to assertion plus non-nullness entails xizi_sll_node for the simplified postconditions.
forbidden_patterns: Do not use QCP_demos_human or Applications_human as references.
Do not replace first-removal semantics with Coq List.remove or any remove-all operator.
Do not weaken or alter the existing strong_spec, mirror the C traversal as a new Rocq algorithm, hand-edit generated files, add Admitted/Axiom, or use forbidden lemmas.
reference_case_hints: QCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/kmp_rel.c for named specification derivation syntax.
